title: Locations match request paths
summary: A location block chooses handling for matching request paths. Simple prefix locations are useful for organising a static site.
introduction: A location block chooses handling for matching request paths. Simple prefix locations are useful for organising a static site. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A location block chooses handling for matching request paths. Simple prefix locations are useful for organising a static site.
The prefix matches paths beginning with /assets/. With root, the assets part stays in the resulting path.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: root and alias combine paths differently; do not interchange them without checking.
